notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to the opponent that has Grievous Wound attached to them.
easyPrerequisites: Grievous Wound attached to an opponent.
description:
Deal damage to the opponent that has Grievous Wound attached to them.
Grievous Wound triggers, causing the opponent to lose at least their entire life total due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz.
The opponent with Grievous Wound attached loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
